pli-tv-kd15:8.2.19: evameva kho tayā bhāradvāja, chavassa dārupattassa kāraṇā gihīnaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.20: netaṃ bhāradvāja, appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā vā bhiyyobhāvāya. atha khvetaṃ bhāradvāja appasannānaṃ ceva appasādāya pasannānaṃ ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.25: bhindathetaṃ bhikkhave, dārupattaṃ. sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ katvā bhikkhūnaṃ añjanūpapisanaṃ detha.
pli-tv-kd15:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvace patte dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.1: tena kho pana samayena pattamūlaṃ ghaṃsiyati.
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.18: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū citrāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhārenti rūpakākiṇṇāni bhittikammakatāni.
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.23: “na bhikkhave, citrāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhāretabbāni rūpakākiṇṇāni bhittikammakatāni.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saudakaṃ pattaṃ paṭisāmenti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.7: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sodakaṃ pattaṃ otāpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave, vodakaṃ katvā otāpetvā pattaṃ paṭisāmetu”nti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.13: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū uṇhe pattaṃ nidahanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.18: anujānāmi bhikkhave, muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetvā pattaṃ paṭisāmetu”nti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā pattā ajjhokāse anādhārā nikkhittā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū miḍhante pattaṃ nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū paribhaṇḍante pattaṃ nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.15: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chamāya pattaṃ nikkujjanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhittikhilepi nāgadantakepi pattaṃ laggenti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.6: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū mañce pattaṃ nikkhipanti, satisammosā nisīdantā ottharitvā pattaṃ bhindanti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū pīṭhe pattaṃ nikkhipanti, satisammosā nisīdantā ottharitvā pattaṃ bhindanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.14: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū aṅke pattaṃ nikkhipanti, satisammosā vuṭṭhahanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.19: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chatte pattaṃ nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.20: vātamaṇḍalikāya chattaṃ ukkhipīyati. paripatitvā patto bhijjati.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.24: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū pattahatthā kavāṭaṃ paṇāmenti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū tumbakaṭāhe piṇḍāya caranti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.1.7: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ghaṭikaṭāhe piṇḍāya caranti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sabbapaṃsukūliko hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.2.6: ‘kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā chavasīsassa pattaṃ dhāressanti, seyyathāpi pisācillikā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū calakānipi aṭṭhikānipi ucchiṭṭhodakampi pattena nīharanti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.3.3: ‘yasmiṃ yevime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā bhuñjanti sova nesaṃ paṭiggahoti’.
pli-tv-kd15:10.3.5: “na bhikkhave, calakāni vā aṭṭhikāni vā ucciṭṭhodakaṃ vā pattena nīharitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū hatthena vipāṭetvā cīvaraṃ sibbenti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.5: tena kho pana samayena saṅghassa daṇḍasatthakaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.8: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvace satthakadaṇḍe dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimayanti.”
pli-tv-kd15:11.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kukkuṭapattena pi veḷupesikāya pi cīvaraṃ sibbenti
pli-tv-kd15:11.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū tattha tattha khilaṃ nikhanitvā sambandhitvā cīvaraṃ sibbanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.3.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, kaṭhinaṃ, kaṭhinarajjuṃ. tattha tattha obandhitvā cīvaraṃ sibbetunti”.
pli-tv-kd15:11.3.15: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, daṇḍakaṭhinaṃ vidalakaṃ salākaṃ vinandhanarajjuṃ vinandhanasuttakaṃ vinandhitvā cīvaraṃ sibbetunti”.
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū adhotehi pādehi kaṭhinaṃ akkamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.6: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū allehi pādehi kaṭhinaṃ akkamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.11: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saupāhanā kaṭhinaṃ akkamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvaraṃ sibbentā aṅguliyā paṭigaṇhanti,
pli-tv-kd15:11.5.5: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvace paṭiggahodhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpīmayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.5.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ
pli-tv-kd15:11.5.13: tena kho pana samayena sūciyopi satthakāpi paṭiggahāpi nassanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū abbhokāse cīvaraṃ sibbantā sītenapi uṇhenapi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.6.17: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikaṃ cīvaravaṃsaṃ cīvararajjukanti”.
pli-tv-kd15:11.7.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvaraṃ sibbetvā tattheva kaṭhinaṃ ujjhitvā pakkamanti. undurehi pi upacikāhi pi khajjati.
pli-tv-kd15:11.7.8: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kuḍḍe pi thambhe pi kaṭhinaṃ ussāpetvā pakkamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.7.11: “anujānāmi bhikkhave bhittikhīle vā nāgadante vā laggetunti”.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.1: atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sūcikampi satthakampi bhesajjampi pattena ādāya gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.7: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu upāhanāyo kāyabandhanena bandhitvā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.8: aññataro upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādento upāhanāyo sīsena ghaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.10: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena antarāmagge udakaṃ akappiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū kosalesu janapadesu addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.7: atha kho so bhikkhu pipāsāya pīḷito upanaddhaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.11: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.12: “kimpana tvaṃ āvuso parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na adāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti,
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.15: ‘kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na dassatī’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.16: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.17: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ paṭipucchi
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.18: ‘saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na adāsī’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.21: ‘ananucchavikaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.22: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na dassasi?
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.23: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya. atha khvetaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ ceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.26: “na bhikkhave, addhānamaggappaṭipannena bhikkhunā parissāvanaṃ yāciyamānena na dātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.28: na ca bhikkhave aparissāvanakena addhāno paṭipajjitabbo.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.30: sace na hoti parissāvanaṃ vā dhammakaraṇo vā saṅghāṭikaṇṇo pi adhiṭṭhātabbo
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ .
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.3: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū navakammaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū makasehi ubbāḷhā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena vesāliyaṃ paṇītānaṃ bhattānaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭi adhiṭṭhitā hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.2: bhikkhū paṇītāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā abhisannakāyā honti bahvābādhā.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.3: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco vesāliṃ agamāsi kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.4: addasā kho jīvako komārabhacco bhikkhū abhisannakāye bahvābādhe.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.5: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jīvako komārabhacco bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.8: sādhu bhante bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ caṅkamañca jantāgharañca anujānātu.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.10: atha kho bhagavā jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.11: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:14.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū visame caṅkame caṅkamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.2.16: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū caṅkame caṅkamantā paripatanti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.2.19: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajjhokāse caṅkamantā sītenapi uṇhenapi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.2.24: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikaṃ cīvaravaṃsaṃ cīvararajjunti.”
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.12: “anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ piṭṭhasaṅghāṭaṃ udukkhalikaṃ uttarapāsakaṃ aggalavaṭṭikaṃ kapisīsakaṃ sūcikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ tālacchiddaṃ āviñjanachiddaṃ āviñjanarajjunti”.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.13: jantāgharassa kuḍḍapādo jīrati. bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.17: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū khuddake jantāghare majjhe aggiṭṭhānaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.20: “anujānāmi bhikkhave khuddake jantāghare ekamantaṃ aggiṭṭhānaṃ kātuṃ, mahallake majjhe”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.40: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū jantāghare chamāya nisīdanti. gattāni kaṇḍūvanti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.43: tena kho pana samayena jantāgharaṃ aparikkhittaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.4.14: “anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ piṭṭhasaṅghāṭaṃ udukkhalikaṃ uttarapāsakaṃ aggalavaṭṭiṃ kapisīsakaṃ sūcikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ tālacchiddaṃ āviñjanachiddaṃ āviñjanarajjunti.”
pli-tv-kd15:14.4.17: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikanti.
pli-tv-kd15:15.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū naggā naggaṃ abhivādenti.
pli-tv-kd15:15.1.2: naggā naggaṃ abhivādāpenti. naggā naggassa parikammaṃ karonti. naggā naggassa parikammaṃ kārāpenti. naggā naggassa denti. naggā paṭigaṇhanti. naggā khādanti. naggā bhuñjanti. naggā sāyanti. naggā pivanti.
pli-tv-kd15:15.1.4: “na bhikkhave naggena naggo abhivādetabbo. yo abhivādeyya āpatti dukkaṭassa. na naggena naggo abhivādāpetabbo …pe…
pli-tv-kd15:16.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū jantāghare chamāya cīvaraṃ nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.1.15: “anujānāmi bhikkhave ogumbetvā ullittāvalittaṃ kātuṃ setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikaṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū jantāgharepi udakepi parikammaṃ kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.5.1: tena kho pana samayena jantāghare udakaṃ na hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.17: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū valliyāpi kāyabandhanenapi udakaṃ vāhenti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.25: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajjhokāse udakaṃ vāhanto sītenapi uṇhenapi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.30: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikaṃ cīvaravaṃsaṃ cīvararajjunti.”
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.31: udapāno apāruto hoti. tiṇacuṇṇehipi paṃsukehipi okiriyati.
pli-tv-kd15:17.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ārāme tahaṃ tahaṃ nahāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:17.1.14: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ gattāni sītikāni honti.
pli-tv-kd15:17.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako saṅghassa atthāya pokkharaṇiṃ kāretukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:17.2.14: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu saṅghassa atthāya nillekhaṃ jantāgharaṃ kattukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cātumāsaṃ nisīdanena vippavasanti.
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.5: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pupphābhikiṇṇesu sayanesu sayanti
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.6: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.11: tena kho pana samayena manussā gandhampi mālampi ādāya ārāmaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.14: “anujānāmi bhikkhave gandhaṃ gahetvā kavāṭe pañcaṅgulikaṃ dātuṃ, pupphaṃ gahetvā vihāre ekamantaṃ nikkhipitunti.”
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saṅghassa namatakaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.7: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū āsittakūpadhāne bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.13: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.14: so bhuñjamāno na sakkoti hatthena pattaṃ sandhāretuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:19.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ekabhājane pi bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.2.2: ekathālake pi pivanti. ekamañce pi tuvaṭṭenti. ekattharaṇā pi tuvaṭṭenti. ekapāpuraṇā pi tuvaṭṭenti. ekattharaṇāpāpuraṇā pi tuvaṭṭenti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.1: tena kho pana samayena vaḍḍho licchavī mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sahāyo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.2: atha kho vaḍḍho licchavī yena mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.5: dutiyampi kho vaḍḍho licchavī mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.8: tatiyampi kho vaḍḍho licchavī mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.11: “kyāhaṃ ayyānaṃ aparajjhāmi? kissa maṃ ayyā nālapantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.12: “tathā hi pana tvaṃ āvuso vaḍḍha amhe dabbena mallaputtena viheṭhiyamāne ajjhupekkhasī?ti”
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.14: ‘sace kho tvaṃ āvuso vaḍḍha, iccheyyāsi, ajjeva bhagavā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ nāsāpeyyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.15: ‘kyāhaṃ ayyā karomi? kiṃ mayā sakkā kātunti’
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.16: ‘ehi tvaṃ āvuso vaḍḍha, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.18: yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā, sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.21: ayyena me dabbena mallaputtena pajāpati dūsitā”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.1: ‘evaṃ ayyā’ti kho vaḍḍho licchavī mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vaḍḍho licchavī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.4: yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā,
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.7: ayyena me dabbena mallaputtena pajāpati dūsitā”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.8: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.9: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ vaḍḍho āhā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.12: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.13: “sarasi tvaṃ dabba evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ vaḍḍho āhā”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.18: “yatohaṃ bhante jāto, nābhijānāmi supinantena’pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitā, pageva jāgaro”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.2: “tena hi bhikkhave saṅgho vaḍḍhassa licchavissa pattaṃ nikkujjatu asambhogaṃ saṅghena karotu.
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa patto nikkujjitabbo:
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.4: bhikkhūnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati, bhikkhūnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati, bhikkhūnaṃ avāsāya parisakkati. bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati. bhikkhū bhikkhūhi bhedeti. buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa pattaṃ nikkujjituṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.4: vaḍḍho licchavī āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃseti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.5: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho vaḍḍhassa licchavissa pattaṃ nikkujjeyya asambhogaṃ saṅghena kareyya”.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.8: vaḍḍho licchavī āyasmantaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃseti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.9: saṅgho vaḍḍhassa licchavissa pattaṃ nikkujjati. asambhogaṃ saṅghena karoti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.10: yassāyasmato khamati vaḍḍhassa licchavissa pattassa nikkujjanā asambhogaṃ saṅghena karaṇaṃ, so tuṇhassa,
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.12: nikkujjito saṅghena vaḍḍhassa licchavissa patto asambhogo saṅghena,
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.13: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena vaḍḍhassa licchavissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā vaḍḍhaṃ licchaviṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.5: “saṅghena kira me patto nikkujjito asambhogo’mhi kira saṅghenā”ti
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.7: atha kho vaḍḍhassa licchavissa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā vaḍḍhaṃ licchaviṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.8: “alaṃ āvuso vaḍḍha, mā soci, mā paridevi.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.10: atha kho vaḍḍho licchavī saputtadāro samittāmacco sañātisālohito allavattho allakeso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.11: “accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yohaṃ ayyaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsesiṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.12: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.13: “taggha tvaṃ āvuso vaḍḍha accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ dabbaṃ mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.14: yato ca kho tvaṃ āvuso vaḍḍha accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, taṃ te mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.15: vuddhihesā āvuso vaḍḍha ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatī”ti.

pli-tv-kd15:20.7.2: tena bhikkhave vaḍḍhena licchavinā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.3: saṅghena me bhante patto nikkujjito, asambhogom’hi saṅghena,
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.4: so’haṃ bhante sammā vattāmi lomaṃ pātemi. netthāraṃ vattāmi. saṅghaṃ pattukkujjanaṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.9: saṅghena vaḍḍhassa licchavissa patto nikkujjito asambhogo saṅghena.

pli-tv-kd15:20.7.14: saṅghena vaḍḍhassa licchavissa patto nikkujjito asambhogo saṅghena.

pli-tv-kd15:21.1.1: dutiya bhāṇavāraṃ. atha kho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena bhaggā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bhaggā tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.4: tena kho pana samayena bodhissa rājakumārassa kokanado nāma pāsādo acirakārito hoti anajjhāvuttho samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.5: atha kho bodhirājakumāro sañjikāputtaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.6: “ehi tvaṃ samma sañcikāputta, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda,
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.7: appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.8: ‘bodhi bhante rājakumāro bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.10: ‘adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.11: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho sañcikāputto māṇavo bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.12: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sañcikāputto māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.13: bodhi kho rājakumāro bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.15: ‘adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.1: atha kho sañjikāputto māṇavo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bodhirājakumāro tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.2: “avocumha kho mayaṃ bhoto vacanena taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.3: ‘bodhi kho rājakumāro bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.5: adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.7: atha kho bodhirājakumāro tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā, kokanadañca pāsādaṃ odātehi dussehi santharāpetvā yāva pacchimā sopānakalebarā sañcikāputtaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.8: ehi tvaṃ samma sañcikāputta, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocehi
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.10: ‘evambho’ti kho sañcikāputto māṇavo bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.12: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena bodhissa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.13: tena kho pana samayena bodhirājakumāro bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ āgamayamāno.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.14: addasā kho bodhirājakumāro bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.15: disvāna tato paccuggantvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā purakkhatvā yena kokanado pāsādo tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.16: atha kho bhagavā pacchimaṃ sopāṇakalebaraṃ nissāya aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.18: ‘akkamatu bhante bhagavā dussāni, akkamatu sugato dussāni, yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.22: ‘akkamatu bhante bhagavā dussāni, akkamatu sugato dussāni, yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.23: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ apalokesi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.24: atha kho āyasmā ānando bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.26: na bhagavā celapattikaṃ akkamissati. pacchimaṃ janataṃ tathāgato anukampatī’ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.1: atha kho bodhi rājakumāro dussāni [saṃharāpetvā uparikokanade pāsāde āsanaṃ paññāpesi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.2: atha kho bhagavā kokanadaṃ pāsādaṃ abhirūhitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.3: atha kho bodhirājakumāro buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.5: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthī apagatagabbhā bhikkhū nimantetvā dussaṃ paññāpetvā etadavoca
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.6: atha kho sā itthī ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā maṅgalatthāya yāciyamānā celappatikaṃ nākkamissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassā itthiyā ujjhāyantiyā khīyantiyā vipācentiyā.
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave gihīnaṃ maṅgalatthāya yāciyamānena celappatikaṃ akkamitunti”.
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.12: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dhotapādakaṃ akkamituṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.1: atha kho bhagavā bhaggesu yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.

pli-tv-kd15:22.2.1: atha kho visākhā migāramātā vidhūpanañca tālavaṇṭañca ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.

pli-tv-kd15:23.2.8: “ete kho ayya, tumhākaṃ bhadantā chattapaggahitā āgacchanti seyyathāpi gaṇakamahāmattā”ti.

pli-tv-kd15:23.2.14: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

pli-tv-kd15:26.1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā odane dīyamāne na sakkaccaṃ paṭiggahessanti. ekamekaṃ sitthaṃ kammasatena niṭṭhāyatī”ti.

pli-tv-kd15:27.1.8: atha kho sā itthī attano nakhehi gattāni vilikhitvā kuppaṃ akāsi:
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.11: addasāsuṃ kho te manussā tassā itthiyā nakhesu chavimpi lohitampi.
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.15: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.

pli-tv-kd15:27.1.19: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu dīghe nakhe dhāressantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.20: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:27.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū nakhenapi nakhaṃ chindanti, mukhenapi nakhaṃ chindanti, kuḍḍepi nakhaṃ ghaṃsanti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.2.8: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vīsatimaṭṭaṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ kesā dīghā honti.

pli-tv-kd15:27.3.7: “anujānāmi bhikkhave khuraṃ khurasilaṃ khurasipāṭikaṃ namatakaṃ sabbaṃ khurabhaṇḍanti.”
pli-tv-kd15:27.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū massuṃ kappāpenti,
pli-tv-kd15:27.4.21: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno sambādhe vaṇo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.4.24: anujānāmi bhikkhave ābādhappaccayā sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpetunti.”

pli-tv-kd15:27.5.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno sīse vaṇo hoti, na sakkoti khurena kese oropetuṃ.

pli-tv-kd15:27.5.16: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sakkharikāyapi madhusitthakenapi nāsikālomaṃ gāhāpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.5.20: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū palitaṃ gāhāpenti.

pli-tv-kd15:27.6.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimayanti.”

pli-tv-kd15:28.2.16: “anujānāmi bhikkhave tantakaṃ vemakaṃ vaṭṭaṃ salākaṃ sabbaṃ tantabhaṇḍakanti.”.

pli-tv-kd15:31.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dantakaṭṭhaṃ na khādanti.
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.5: acakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo na visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ pariyonandhati, bhattamassa nacchādeti.
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.6: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane.
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.8: cakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ na duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ na pariyonandhati, bhattamassa chādeti.
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.9: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane.
pli-tv-kd15:31.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dīghāni dantakaṭṭhāni khādanti. teheva sāmaṇeraṃ ākoṭenti.
pli-tv-kd15:31.2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgulaparamaṃ dantakaṭṭhaṃ, na ca tena sāmaṇero ākoṭetabbo.
pli-tv-kd15:31.2.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno atimaṭāhakaṃ dantakaṭṭhaṃ khādantassa kaṇṭhe vilaggaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dāyaṃ ālimpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.7: tena kho pana samayena vihārā tiṇagahaṇā honti. davaḍāhe ḍayhamāne vihārā ḍayhanti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.8: bhikkhū kukkuccāyanti paṭaggiṃ dātuṃ parittaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.10: “anujānāmi bhikkhave davaḍāhe ḍayhamāne paṭaggiṃ dātuṃ parittaṃ kātunti.”
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rukkhaṃ abhiruhanti. rukkhā rukkhaṃ saṅkamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno kosalesu janapade sāvatthiṃ gacchantassa antarāmagge hatthī pariyuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.8: atha kho so bhikkhu rukkhamūlaṃ upadhāvitvā kukkuccāyanto rukkhaṃ na abhiruhi.
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.10: atha kho so bhikkhu sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.12: “anujānāmi bhikkhave sati karaṇīye porisaṃ rukkhaṃ abhiruhituṃ āpadāsu yāvadatthanti”.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.1: tena kho pana samayena yameḷutekulā nāma bhikkhū dve bhātikā honti brāhmaṇajātikā kalyāṇavācā kalyāṇavākkaraṇā.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.2: te yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.4: “etarahi bhante bhikkhū nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.6: handa mayaṃ bhante buddhavacanaṃ chandaso āropemā”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.8: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā evaṃ vakkhatha
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.10: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya. atha khvetaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ ceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave sakāya niruttiyā buddhavacanaṃ pariyāpuṇitunti”.

pli-tv-kd15:33.2.6: “api nu kho bhikkhave lokāyate sāradassāvī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.

pli-tv-kd15:33.2.24: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tiracchānavijjaṃ vācenti.

pli-tv-kd15:33.3.8: “api nu kho bhikkhave khipite jīvāti vutte tappaccayā jīveyya vā mareyya vā”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.3.12: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhikkhūnaṃ khipite ‘jīvatha bhante’ti vadanti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.3.15: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jīvatha bhanteti vuccamānā nālapissantī’ti.

pli-tv-kd15:34.1.6: addasā kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:34.1.8: “kinnu kho so bhikkhave bhikkhu ekamantaṃ nisinno”ti.
pli-tv-kd15:34.1.13: “api nu kho bhikkhave taṃ khāditabbaṃ yaṃ khāditvā evarūpāya dhammakathāya paribāhiro assā”ti.

pli-tv-kd15:35.2.21: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, santharitvā majjhe chiddaṃ katvā vaccaṃ kātunti”.

pli-tv-kd15:35.4.7: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭikanti.
pli-tv-kd15:35.4.20: ācamanapādukā pākaṭā honti. bhikkhū hirīyanti ācametuṃ.

pli-tv-kd15:36.1.4: te kulitthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājanepi bhuñjanti, ekathālakepi pivanti, ekāsanepi nisīdanti, ekamañcepi tuvaṭṭenti, ekattharaṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti, ekattharaṇapāvuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti, vikālepi bhuñjanti, majjampi pivanti, mālāgandhavilepanampi dhārenti, naccantipi, gāyantipi, vādentipi, lāsentipi,

pli-tv-kd15:37.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmante uruvelakassape pabbajite saṅghassa bahuṃ lohabhaṇḍaṃ dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:37.1.3: “kinnu kho bhagavatā lohabhaṇḍaṃ anuññātaṃ kiṃ ananuññātaṃ,
